playTime.name: Show Playtime
playTime.description: Displays the total playtime for each world in the world selection screen.

worldSize.name: Show World Size
worldSize.description: Displays the disk space used by each world in the world selection screen.

worldIcon.name: Update World Icons
worldIcon.description: Updates world icons when entering a world to keep them up to date.

unpaused.name: Unpaused
unpaused.description: Keeps the game running even when the pause menu is open.

backup.name: Backup
backup.description: Automatically creates a ZIP backup of your world in the background when you leave it.

customBackupFolder.name: Custom Backup Folder
customBackupFolder.description: Stores world backups in a folder of your choice instead of the "backups" folder in your Minecraft directory.

backupFolder.name: Backup Folder
backupFolder.description: The folder where world backups are stored. Relative paths start from your Minecraft directory.

maxBackups.name: Max Backups per World
maxBackups.description: The oldest backups of a world are deleted once this limit is reached. 0 = unlimited.
